title: Always-on stack on this PC: one supervisor starts and restarts Redis, worker+beat, API, web and the Cloudflare tunnel at logon
acceptance_criteria: Warren's request 2026-10-07: 'lets start with getting the system ALWAYS ON using cloud flare like we were doing which did work'

One supervisor script starts every missing component (WSL Redis, Celery worker with beat, API on 127.0.0.1:8001, production web on 127.0.0.1:3000, cloudflared) and restarts any that die, checking at least every 60 seconds
Starts at Windows logon without admin rights (per-user Startup entry); Postgres stays the existing automatic service
Web binds 127.0.0.1, never 0.0.0.0; the tunnel refuses to start unless CIP_AUTH_MODE=session and /api/v1/auth/me answers 401
The current public address is read from the cloudflared metrics endpoint and written to one local status file; no bracketed URL pattern appears in any shell command
Measured: kill each component once and see it return; public /login 200 and unauthenticated /api/v1/auth/me 401 after the restart
Nothing writes to cip business tables; no Docker; no admin-only system setting is changed by the agent
